calendar.title: Installment calendar
calendar.lead: <m>{{amount}}</m> of the next {{count}} months is already committed to installments.
calendar.leadAfter: From {{month}} on it is at most <m>{{amount}}</m> a month.
calendar.empty: No installments yet. Upload a statement and the plans appear here.
calendar.chartLabel: Installment total per month. Details in the table below.
calendar.planCaption: Each row is one installment plan. A cell shows the amount due that month and which installment it is.
calendar.cashTitle: What a cash advance installment contains
calendar.cashLead: Each installment carries <m>{{extra}}</m> of interest and tax. Over the remaining {{count}} installments that is <m>{{totalExtra}}</m> on top of the principal.

month.title: Month
month.leadChange: The month before was <m>{{previous}}</m>, a change of {{percent}}.
month.leadNoPrevious: There is no previous month to compare with.
month.empty: No statement uploaded for this month.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.lead_one: {{count}} recurring charge found; <m>{{amount}}</m> in the latest month.
subscriptions.lead_other: {{count}} recurring charges found; <m>{{amount}}</m> in the latest month.
subscriptions.leadNoRise: No subscription went up in the latest month.
subscriptions.rule: A charge counts as a subscription when the same merchant appears in at least two consecutive months and the amount moves by less than 25 percent.

watch.title: Watch items
watch.pending: Preparing the commentary. This can take 10 to 60 seconds.
watch.none: This statement has not been analysed yet.
watch.sentData: Only the date, description, amount, currency and type of each line go to the chosen provider.
watch.noProvider: Choose an AI provider before asking for commentary.
watch.noCites: This point is not tied to a single transaction.
watch.disclaimer: Totals and installment figures are computed in code. The model only adds categories and commentary.
watch.noStatements: No statements yet. Upload one to get commentary.

upload.title: Upload statement
upload.intro: Upload your credit card statement as a PDF. It is read on this computer; card number, name and address are removed before anything is stored.
upload.notPdf: Only PDF files can be uploaded.
upload.reconOkBody: The balance printed on the statement equals the sum of the lines read: <m>{{amount}}</m>.
upload.reconMismatchBody: The statement prints a balance of <m>{{expected}}</m>; the lines read add up to <m>{{computed}}</m>. The difference is <m>{{difference}}</m>.
upload.reconMismatchWhy: A line may not have been read, or the statement shows an item separately.
upload.reconMismatchNext: Calculations use the lines that were read. Compare with the bank’s own transaction list before paying.
upload.errUnknown: This PDF’s layout was not recognised. For now only statements from supported banks can be read.
upload.errTooLarge: The file is larger than 10 MB.
upload.errNetwork: The local back end did not answer.

setup.title: Setup
setup.providerIntro: A tool installed on this computer can suggest categories and write a short commentary. Without one, kalan only does the arithmetic.
setup.example: Amounts and dates look like this: {{amount}}, {{date}}.
setup.privacy1: Statements are read and stored on this computer. The local back end listens on 127.0.0.1 only.
setup.privacy2: Card number, name, address, IBAN and customer number are removed before anything is stored.
setup.privacy3: The provider you choose receives only the date, description, amount, currency and type of each line, plus totals computed in code.
setup.privacy4: Totals and installment figures are computed in code; the model produces no numbers.
setup.privacy5: kalan is open source (MIT licence). You can check all of this by reading the code.

manual.title: Add purchase
manual.intro: Add a purchase that is not on a statement yet.
manual.amountInvalid: Write the amount in digits, for example 1,149.50.
manual.addedPlan: Purchase in {{count}} installments added to the calendar.
